title: Pack
description: A fully-authored node pack produced at Stage 5 of the Arbor build pipeline and consumed by the teaching runtime.

schema_version.description: Schema version; must be 1 for this contract.

node_id.description: Kebab-case slug matching node.id in the SQLite graph.

templates.description: Parameterised question templates for custom tests and FSRS cards. At least one per difficulty level (easy/medium/hard) — invariant enforced by the pack loader, not this schema.

diagnostic.description: Diagnostic bank: ≥10 items, each mapped to outcome_refs. The runtime draws exactly 10 per attempt, sampling across outcomes. Bank size > 10 prevents verbatim repeats across test-out and retakes.

summary_for_context.description: Compact node summary injected into the cheap teaching-model context. Hard cap: 800 characters.

addenda.description: Numbered repair addenda appended after authoring. Empty array on initial authoring.

summary_for_learner.description: Human-readable overview shown before teaching begins.

outline.description: Bullet-point outline of what will be taught.

assumed_children.description: node_id values of prerequisite children assumed completed.

question.description: The Socratic question posed to the learner. KaTeX-renderable.

expected_paths.description: Classifier paths. Invariant (code-enforced): at least one path has is_misconception: true.

hint_ladder.description: Hint sequence in ascending support: probe → nudge → near-answer → tell. Invariant (code-enforced): last step must have level: 'tell'. Floor guarantee: learner can never be permanently stuck.

resolution.description: Scripted resolution delivered after a correct answer or after 'tell'.

quick_checks.description: Short comprehension checks after the resolution.

label.description: Short label for this answer category (e.g., 'correct', 'sign-error').

classifier_hint.description: Natural-language hint for the cheap classifier model.

response.description: Scripted response delivered when this path is matched.

is_misconception.description: True when this path represents a misconception that needs addressing.

level.description: Severity level. 'tell' is mandatory as the final step (code-enforced).

stem.description: Question text; KaTeX-renderable. May contain {param_name} placeholders.

parameters.description: Named parameter ranges for re-rolling. Omit for non-parameterised templates.

answer_expr.description: Sympy-parseable expression. May reference parameter names. Example: 'a**2 + b**2'.

marking_notes.description: Guidance for the strong model when judging free-form conceptual answers.

is_parameterized.description: True when answer_expr and param_seed are used instead of expected_answer for checking.

param_seed.description: Seed for parameter re-roll; only present when is_parameterized: true.

answer_expr.description: Sympy expression; only present when is_parameterized: true.

outcome_refs.description: Outcome identifiers (from node.outcomes_json) this item tests.

reason.description: Why this addendum was written (repair report reference).

content.description: The addendum content; injected alongside the original segment.
